description: Baseline reproduction: balanced sampler + FULL existing yunet_clean augmentation (RandomResizedCrop + resolution-loss-sim + flip/rotation/ColorJitter + blur + JPEG). Verifies reproducibility of the existing checkpoint's training recipe.
transform_repr:
Compose(
      Resize(size=[224, 224], interpolation=bilinear, antialias=True)
      RandomResizedCrop(size=(224, 224), scale=(0.85, 1.0), ratio=(0.95, 1.05), interpolation=bilinear, antialias=True)
      <function simulate_native_resolution_loss at 0x000000004ADD4510>
      RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
      RandomRotation(degrees=[-5.0, 5.0], interpolation=nearest, expand=False, fill=0)
      ColorJitter(brightness=(0.8, 1.2), contrast=(0.8, 1.2), saturation=(0.9, 1.1))
      RandomApply(    GaussianBlur(kernel_size=(3, 3), sigma=[0.1, 1.0]))
      ToImage()
      JPEG(quality=(40, 100))
      ToDtype(scale=True)
      Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225], inplace=False)
)
